title: MACDONALD: Murdering the Inconvenient
text:
You won’t have had any trouble finding a suitable amount of justified outrage over Massachusetts Governor Maura Healey signing the death-at-birth warrant, doing business as the Orwellian-sounding “Prioritizing Patient Access to Care Act.”
Prioritizing what?
I remember when babies were patients, especially in the third trimester, when they are more than capable of surviving outside the womb, even in Massachusetts.
Correction. Babies are still patients in the third trimester (and quite often the other two) except for reasons almost no one but left-wing Massachusetts legislators and their blood-sucking political party brethren can fathom. Most of them women. Some of them with children, though that is increasingly less likely as generations of girls are brought up to believe men can need a gynecologist for something other than their wives.
Babies are only “people” in the eyes of the mother and her progressive government if she is allowed to decide. That’s an awful risk, given how the same lot has an ideological history of othering blacks, Jews, and more recently anyone who disagrees with them about babies in any trimester. Socialists, be they national, soviet, or Democratic, have the nagging tendency to anesthetize the people into believing “they,” whoever they may be, are not in fact human beings.
Treating them like garbage is just good public policy, which includes mob intimidation, beatings, theft, incarceration, and death.
Healy is just affirming her party’s commitment to murdering the inconvenient. It’s babies today, but it could just as easily be you tomorrow, and she is not an exception in this. Her entire party operates this way.
You are only useful when you do what they require or can provide some service to the party, even if reluctantly. Like letting them rob you of your property to pay for what’s important to them.
Should you dare to object, or persist in your opposition, you can expect your own life to have as much value as an unwanted third-trimester baby in the State of Massachusetts.
And those who praise the othering of life at birth can’t begin to be trusted not to take a similar stance when it suits their political priorities, at any age before natural death.
Regardless of what they say, they always show you who you are. Ignore the message and the warning at your own peril.

Babies are still patients in the third trimester (and quite often the other two) except for reasons almost no one but left-wing Massachusetts legislators and their blood-sucking political party brethren can fathom.
